color.note: Dark is the primary theme. c0 is the ground and c1 the figure; bg and fg point at them and are rebound wherever a scope flips (the paper section, a hovered card). The site derives fg-2, fg-3, bg-2, bg-3, rule and rule-2 with color-mix from bg and fg; the values here are those mixes resolved on the default ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Near-black, never pure #000. The ground in dark, the figure in light. Use through bg or fg, not directly.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Warm off-white. The figure in dark, the ground (paper) in light. Use through bg or fg, not directly.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The one phosphor accent: a status light, never a wash. LEDs, the caret, progress rules, tier and team bars, and at most one accent panel or button per view (Register, Sponsor us, the arrow panel). Light theme: 2.66:1 on bone, so never amber text or a meaning-carrying amber mark on paper without a word beside it.

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an amber fill (10.5:1 dark, 6.0:1 light). Never white on amber.

tokens.name: amber-label
tokens.usage: Mono labels sitting on an amber panel (amber-ink 78% into amber). 6.7:1 dark; 4.40:1 light, just under 4.5, kept exact from the site.

tokens.name: cut
tokens.usage: The flat cut-out slab behind the lines of a line-art scene (the grey wedge). Decorative only; never text, never a border.

tokens.name: c0
tokens.usage: The ground of the current scope. Rebind bg to c1 to flip a scope to paper.

tokens.name: c1
tokens.usage: The figure of the current scope.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Every panel paints its own bg; the page body too. Flips to c1 inside .scheme-paper and on a hovered card or panel link.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text, the focus ring, button fill on hover. 15.8:1 on bg (dark), 16.0:1 (light).

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, nav links, blurbs, metadata. On bg 6.8:1 dark / 5.2:1 light; on bg-2 6.5:1 / 5.0:1; in the paper scope 5.4:1 / 7.1:1.

tokens.name: fg-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: footnotes, FAQ numbers, countdown separators, inactive LEDs. On bg 4.57:1 dark / 4.60:1 light. Kept exact from the site where it misses: 4.46:1 / 4.41:1 on bg-2, and 3.45:1 in the dark theme's paper scope, so keep fg-3 text off bg-2 and off paper in dark.

tokens.name: bg-2
tokens.usage: Raised wells: the ground behind card line art (events, team), the current schedule row, FAQ row hover.

tokens.name: bg-3
tokens.usage: A second well step, rarely needed. Never text.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The 1px hairline. Panel grids show it through a 1px gap; section tops, list rows and the header use it as a border. Structural only, it carries no meaning.

tokens.name: rule-2
tokens.usage: Button outlines. 2.21:1 dark / 1.84:1 light, under 3:1 and kept exact from the site; a button is always identified by its label and arrow, never by the outline alone.

type.note: Two Google-hosted families: Instrument Sans (variable, 400–700, used at 450 for display) and DM Mono (400, 500). Display sizes are fluid clamps on the site; fontSize here is the largest step and each usage names the clamp.

families.display: "Instrument Sans", "Instrument Sans Fallback", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, system-ui, sans-serif
families.body: "Instrument Sans", "Instrument Sans Fallback", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "DM Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The hero wordmark only, uppercase, two lines. Fluid: min(clamp(64px, 11.5vw, 150px), 18.5cqw).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section titles in a sticky section head. Sentence case. Fluid: clamp(52px, 10.5vw, 130px), capped at 24cqw.

styles.name: big
styles.usage: Stat numerals, tabular, rolled in on reveal. Fluid: clamp(56px, 8vw, 120px).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles: events, tiers, team names, the countdown. Fluid: clamp(28px, 3vw, 44px).

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Small headlines and track names. Fluid: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px).

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: One night, one project, one demo.
styles.usage: The opening paragraph of a section, max 34ch. Fluid: clamp(20px, 2.3vw, 30px).

styles.name: question
styles.usage: FAQ questions and why-sponsor titles. Fluid: clamp(18px, 1.7vw, 26px).

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Values in status-board and meta cells, schedule rows. Fluid: clamp(16px, 1.3vw, 20px).

styles.name: copy
styles.sample: Sponsors show up with credits, prizes and judges.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: The base size for anything without its own style.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: A Berkeley-founded startup founder and an hour of questions.
styles.usage: Card blurbs, tier lists, footer links, in fg-2.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Button and link labels, nav links.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The name set beside the mark in the header. 14px under 560px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels, eyebrows, canvas tags, ticker items, the log. Usually fg-2. -0.02em on 2x screens.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Times and figures that line up: tabular-nums. Schedule times, the header index.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: The outlined placeholder badge beside anything not real yet. Uppercase, 1px currentColor border.

spacing.note: One scale, used for padding and gaps inside panels. Panels themselves have no gap: they are separated by the 1px rule.

tokens.name: s1
tokens.usage: LED to label, link top margin, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: s2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside cells, schedule row padding, status-board cell padding (block).

tokens.name: s3
tokens.usage: Default cell padding and the minimum side gutter (gl and gr are max(16px, safe-area)).

tokens.name: s4
tokens.usage: Section head padding, gaps between groups in a cell, hero copy padding.

tokens.name: s5
tokens.usage: Block padding, space above a track name, footer mark top.

tokens.name: s6
tokens.usage: About body padding: the largest in-section breathing room.

tokens.name: s7
tokens.usage: Reserved for section-scale separation; the panel grid rarely needs it.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Header height: 60px of cells plus the 1px rule. Also the height of buttons, schedule rows and menu rows.

radius.note: Square everywhere. The only radius on the site is the theme toggle.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every panel, button, card, badge, LED and image.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The theme toggle track, and nothing else.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: The theme toggle's dot, and nothing else.

stroke.note: Line weights. Rules are structure; amber bars are status.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Every hairline: panel-grid gaps, section tops, row dividers, button outlines, the header progress rule.

tokens.name: stroke-rail
tokens.usage: Scrubbed amber progress: the schedule rail and the events progress rule. Also the focus ring.

tokens.name: stroke-bar
tokens.usage: Amber bars across the top of tier and team cards.

tokens.name: led-size
tokens.usage: The square LED, and the tier list bullet.

tokens.name: grain-dark
tokens.usage: The fixed fractal-noise grain over the whole page, dark theme.

tokens.name: grain-light
tokens.usage: The same grain inverted, light theme.

tokens.name: pulse-low
tokens.usage: The low point of the live LED's 2.2s pulse.
